workarounds.symptom: PowerShell guard reads a '\' string literal as the path C:\ and refuses with 'No approval can grant it'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(shell): stop reading a '\' given to .Replace() as the drive root. Target files: src/gaia/agents/tools/shell_tools.py, tests/unit/test_shell_inline_script_paths.py. When the agent tidied paths in a PowerShell one-liner with `.Replace('\','/')`, GAIA refused the whole command as reaching the drive root, with "No approval can grant it", and the agent fell back to slower file tools. Now a separator a string method only searches for is read as text, so the command runs; a real root path such as `Get-ChildItem '\'` is still refused, ... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8102)

workarounds.symptom: CLI: gaia mcp engineering and gaia mcp code-index show their refusal as a traceback
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): gaia mcp engineering and code-index print their refusal, not a traceback. Target files: installer/core/smoke_test.py, src/gaia/mcp/servers/code_index_mcp.py, src/gaia/mcp/servers/engineering_mcp.py. `gaia mcp engineering` without `--developer-mode` and `gaia mcp code-index` from the home directory refuse to start for a stated reason. They now print that reason on stderr and exit 1, with no traceback. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/7536)

workarounds.symptom: 'gaia schedule add' with a taken name prints a Python traceback
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): print one line when gaia schedule add reuses a name. Target files: src/gaia/cli.py, tests/unit/cli/test_cli_schedule.py. `gaia schedule add` with a name that's already taken now prints one error line and exits 1, instead of crashing with a Python traceback. (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8126)

workarounds.symptom: CLI says 'Lemonade server is not installed ... run gaia init' when GAIA's own Lemonade is installed and only the URL is
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(llm): stop calling a custom Lemonade URL "not installed". Target files: src/gaia/llm/lemonade_manager.py, tests/unit/cli/test_model_download_exit_code.py, tests/unit/test_lemonade_not_running_remedy.py. When you point GAIA at your own model server (`LEMONADE_BASE_URL`, or a saved external server) and nothing answers there, commands like `gaia download --list` said Lemonade was "not installed" and told you to run `gaia init`. That's false when GAIA's own Lemonade is installed, and `gaia init` can't fix an unreachable URL anyway.... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/8066)

workarounds.symptom: gaia talk cannot start in the installed build
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(installer): bundle the MCP, talk and notification extras in gaia. Target files: installer/core/freeze.py, installer/core/smoke_test.py, setup.py. In the `gaia` that the installers ship, `gaia mcp serve`, `gaia mcp tui` and `gaia mcp code-index` died on a missing `mcp` module, `gaia talk` stopped on a missing audio library and offered a pip command the program cannot run, and a Windows schedule notification was a message box waiting for a click. The build carried only the Agent UI's dependencies. It now carries all three, refuse... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/7231)

workarounds.symptom: CI: a Launchpad API timeout is reported as "a reason other than a Launchpad outage"
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(installer): name a Launchpad API timeout as an outage. Target files: src/gaia/installer/lemonade_installer.py, tests/unit/test_init_command.py. When Launchpad's API stops answering, the Linux CLI check now says so. It used to say the PPA step failed "for a reason other than a Launchpad outage", which sent authors looking for a bug in their own PR: on 2026-11-11, `main` and several PRs failed this way for hours. A timeout is blamed on Launchpad only when apt reached other repositories, so an offline machine isn't misread as an o... (Ref: https://github.com/amd/gaia/pull/7163)
